title: The Roman Soldier Who Wrote Home Asking for Socks
notes: Lighter register than Days 1 and 2. speaking_rate is 0.95, slightly brisker, and pauses are shorter overall. If a music bed is ever used on this channel, this is the video it suits. Comic timing is welcome.
Tablet 291 (Claudia Severa's birthday invitation, p12) is the centrepiece. It is used twice: introduced at s30, returned to for the handwriting reveal at s35-s38.
Tablet 346 (the socks letter) is NOT on Commons. The cold open and s27-s28 use general tablet photographs instead. Do not label any image on screen as Tablet 346.

The child's shoe (p07) is from Vindolanda itself and is dated c. 200-213 AD, later than the c. AD 100 tablets. It illustrates 'shoes in every size including children's'; do not caption it with a date that implies it is contemporary with the letters.
Heavy use of CC BY-SA. Every one requires attribution. The credits card for this video is longer than usual.
Every archival URL was resolved from the Commons API and checked live.
LOW RESOLUTION: both 'Detail from Roman fort of Vindolanda' images (p06, p14) are only about 30KB. Show them as small cards at native size.
Generated tablets are always blank or closed and tied: never shown with writing, never presented as a specific numbered tablet. The real tablets appear only as photo cards.
Guide object: the pair of woollen socks, which opens the story, recurs, and closes it.
